SEC2+SEC3 round 2: no new material findings. JMAP-fwx5 still present (mdn.rs:271-291 + mod.rs:2299-2322). JMAP-z7we still present (mod.rs:2486 full load before mod.rs:2497 heuristic). JMAP-had9 description updated — 7 fields now, not 5. JMAP-5vpz unchanged. JMAP-bkqp: P3/opinion standing confirmed.
SEC0+SEC1 round 2: one new issue filed. JMAP-vl37 (P1): no test for null/absent forEmailId per-entry invalidProperties path. All other checks clean: (1) null-forEmailId JSON shape correct (type/properties/description keys match SetError wire format); (2) CRLF checks for mdn_gateway/original_message_id are on the SEND path and correctly operate on client-supplied Mdn fields; (3) modifier splitn edge cases all handled (empty modifier string, multiple modifiers, leading/trailing whitespace, empty type_part); (5) using check is non-issue at handler level per architecture; (6) no new panics; (7) parse_mdns JSON template is exhaustive (all 12 Mdn fields enumerated); (8) CRLF check extension follows identical per-entry notSent pattern; (9) MDN_PARSE_MAX_BLOB_IDS rationale comment is sufficient. JMAP-91zr remains open (not resolved by current code).
Confidence: 5% chance of missed P0/P1 bug. Reasoning: (1) The four remaining open issues (JMAP-91zr, JMAP-4l5d, JMAP-fwx5, JMAP-z7we) account for the known gaps. (2) JMAP-91zr (missing 'using' capability check) is the only real correctness bug — a client that omits 'urn:ietf:params:jmap:mdn' from 'using' is not rejected. All other issues are quality/performance improvements. (3) The CRLF check omits the 'error' Vec<String> field but that field is spec-marked server-set and not expected in MDN/send requests, so this is not a functional bug. (4) The forEmailId null check and  pre-check are both correct and tested. (5) No untested code paths were found in the send/parse handlers. (6) The 5% residual represents the non-zero probability of a spec ambiguity (e.g. finalRecipient override semantics, or the 'using' check interacting with dispatcher routing) that has not been exercised by the existing test suite. Running out of real complaints: yes.
